question:
**Direction: Select the word segment that substitutes (replaces) the bracketed word segment correctly and completes the sentence meaningfully:**

Shakespeare was both a dramatist (better than) poet.
solution:
The correct answer is** "and."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"And"** is a conjunction that connects two words or phrases of the same type, indicating that both are included in the statement.
 
• In this sentence, **"Shakespeare was both a dramatist and a poet" **means that he was both a writer of plays and a writer of poetry.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"When not"** suggests a condition or circumstance in which something is not the case.

 
 
• **Example**: *I usually eat breakfast, but when I'm in a hurry, I don't.*
 
 
 
• **"As well as"** is often used to indicate an additional item or action.
 
 
• **Example**: I bought apples as well as oranges at the grocery store.
 
 
 
• **"Or"** is used to present a choice between two options.
 
 
• **Example**: *Do you want tea or coffee?*
